items.label: Season
items.name: Twilight Trails
notes: Daily Discoveries: Max Monday, Raid Hour on Wednesdays and Friendship Friday trades.
Mega debuts include Staraptor and Chandelure; Dynamax Rhyhorn, Sneasel and Sizzlipede join Max Battles.
Dynamax Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf appear on a dedicated Max Battle Day.

items: One extra Candy per trade.
A guaranteed Candy XL from trades with Trainers level 31 and above.
Higher limits for opening Gifts, receiving Gifts from PokéStops and Gym Photo Discs, and storing Gifts.
Daily Adventure Incense lasts twice as long.
More XP and Stardust from hatching Eggs.
Paldea Pokémon arrive, starting with Maschiff and Mabosstiff.
Mega Evolution debuts include Staraptor and Chandelure, with more to come.
Dynamax Rhyhorn, Dynamax Sneasel and Dynamax Sizzlipede appear in Max Battles through the Season; more show up at Power Spots.
Dynamax Uxie, Dynamax Mesprit and Dynamax Azelf appear on a dedicated Max Battle Day.
Daily Discoveries: Max Monday, Raid Hour on Wednesdays and Friendship Friday for in-person trades.
GO Pass and GO Pass Deluxe: earn GO Points from Pass Tasks to climb ranks. Deluxe is the paid track.
Research Breakthrough: Field Research can unlock encounters with Season-themed Pokémon.
New boxes are planned for the Web Store.
12 September, 10 October and 21 November.

items.label: GO Pass
items.name: GO Pass: October
notes: Kyogre encounter at Rank 100; the Deluxe track adds the Lucky Trinket.
Unlimited GO Points on 31 October and 1 November.

items: Kyogre encounter at Rank 100 (Level 20).
The Lucky Trinket returns as the final reward on the Deluxe track.
Runs 6 October, 10:00 am to 3 November, 10:00 am (local time).
Unlimited GO Points: 31 October 12:00 am to 1 November 11:59 pm.
Unclaimed rewards expire 5 November, 10:00 am; the Deluxe Lucky Trinket expires 8 November, 11:59 pm.
Lucky Trinket at Rank 100 and a Super Incubator at Rank 99.
Extra Pokémon encounters, such as Komala, Furfrou, Ampharos, Chansey, Porygon, Snom, Rockruff and Orthworm.
Larger totals of Stardust, XP, Candy, Rare Candy, Max Particles and Poké Balls.
Deluxe: gift of 10 Ultra Balls, 5 Max Revives, 1 Premium Battle Pass and 5 Max Potions.
Deluxe + 10 Ranks: the same, with 2 Premium Battle Passes.
Web-exclusive Ultra Box: 20 Ultra Balls, 10 Max Revives, 10 Max Potions and 5 Premium Battle Passes.
A one-time item that makes you and a friend Lucky Friends, even if you are not Best Friends yet.
Your next trade with that friend makes both Pokémon Lucky.
Needs the friend to be at least Great Friends; you cannot use it on a current Lucky Friend. Trading distance is unchanged.
The same GO Pass: Halloween 2026 continues through Halloween Part II, running from 27 October at 10:00 am to 5 November 2026 at 8:00 pm local time.
The free pass includes event-themed Pokémon encounters, Candy for event-themed Pokémon, Rare Candy, Ultra Balls and additional rewards.
GO Pass Deluxe adds additional encounters, Patissier Top and Patissier Pants, Rare Candy XL, Premium Battle Passes and additional rewards.
Claim all unlocked rewards by 7 November 2026 at 8:00 pm local time.
GO Pass: November runs from 3 November 2026 at 10:00 am to 1 December 2026 at 10:00 am local time.
The free pass includes an encounter with Groudon, 400 PokéCoins, a Lucky Egg, Rare Candy XL, Stardust and additional rewards.
GO Pass Deluxe adds 1,000 additional PokéCoins, a Super Incubator and additional encounters.
Claim all unlocked rewards by 3 December 2026 at 10:00 am local time.
